name: Yume Library
summary: Plays episodes from your own library server, with your own subtitle tracks.
description: Resolves episodes from a server you run and control — your own uploads, your own Hungarian subtitles. Point it at a base URL, optionally give it a JSON index, and it returns a direct stream plus its subtitle tracks. It talks to exactly one host: the one you configure. It does not search the internet, and it has no fallback to anywhere else.

base_url.description: Your library server. Must match the host allowed in this extension's permissions.

index_path.description: A JSON index mapping anime and episode to files. Leave empty to build paths from the pattern below instead.

pattern.description: Used when there is no index. Placeholders: {anilistId} {malId} {episode} {episodePadded} {title} {slug}

subtitle_pattern.description: Where the subtitle file sits, when there is no index. Leave empty if your files carry embedded subtitles.

subtitle_language.description: Language of the subtitle file the pattern points at.

audio_language.description: Audio language of your files. Set this to hu for a dub — it is what makes the sub/dub switch pick correctly.

quality.description: Reported resolution. Used for ranking only.

verify.description: Check that the file exists before offering it. Costs one request; without it a missing episode reaches the player as a dead source.
